title: Special UFO briefing for maintenance teams

tellings.quote: This time they brought us into a special briefing and they told us there's UFOs out in the area.

plain: In 1967 at Malmstrom Air Force Base in Montana, a base that held nuclear missiles, maintenance crews were called into a special briefing and told there were UFOs in the area. The former Air Force officer Robert Salas tells this as what a man named Robert Jameson, who was on those crews, told him. If true, it would mean the Air Force knew of the objects and warned its own men about them.
